title: Vinyasa Flow
long_dsc: Vinyasa Flow is a dynamic and fluid style of yoga that synchronizes breath with movement. It involves a series of poses that flow seamlessly from one to the next, creating a continuous and rhythmic practice. Vinyasa Flow is known for its emphasis on creativity, allowing practitioners to explore different sequences and variations while maintaining a focus on breath awareness.

long_dsc: Prenatal yoga is a gentle form of yoga adapted for pregnancy that combines stretching, mental centering, and focused breathing to support both physical comfort and emotional wellbeing during pregnancy.
